_comment: Unified registry for custom OpenAI-compatible cyber models. One entry here feeds both runtimes: the Python workers (LLM_MODEL=<name>) and the TUI planner (paste the generated opencode.json provider block, then ARGUS_PLANNER_MODEL=<provider>/<model>). See docs/custom-cyber-models.md. Entries under 'examples' are inert documentation — copy one into 'models' and point it at a real server to enable it.

local-white-rabbit.description: Example: WhiteRabbitNeo-style cyber model served locally by Ollama (no key). Run `ollama serve` + `ollama pull <tag>` first.

lab-vllm-cyber.description: Example: team-hosted vLLM endpoint for a security-tuned model; export CYBER_MODEL_API_KEY.
